description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/latlon/rules/central_D2_lon_periodic driven by problems/latlon_diffusion_zonal_periodic.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — NLON is the open metaparameter (NLAT is edge-closed at 5; the lat axis is passive), and the problem's dlon_deg observed divides by the NLON name, so the geometry follows each rebinding automatically. Manufactured decaying solution exp(-kappa (pi/180)^2 t) cos((pi/180) lon), an exact eigenmode of the periodic wrap operator (derivation in the problem file); the recorded errors at t=1.0 are the pure centered second-difference eigenvalue truncation, an exact O(dlon_deg^2) sequence.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

python._doc: Pinned so Python temporal truncation is negligible against the spatial goldens: LSODA at 1e-12/1e-14 handles the stiff diffusion sweep and agrees with the Julia Tsit5 reference to well under the error_vs_golden tolerance on every resolution, where a loose explicit RK method would leave a temporal residue comparable to the spatial error.
